authorization_scope: User requested further necessary qualification and continuation of the next scope. Executor declared a new capped Codex-subscription follow-up before dispatch. Prior consumed allowances are not reused.
allowance: New durable shared allowance; original deadline and all consumption retained across stages.
source_exposure: developer_exposed; original benchmark, additive public checks and exposed-private-control-informed error contract are retained. One related repository stream, no independent confirmation.
calibration_reference_arm: Same task model with fixed generic workflow guidance; no repaired-reference code or private grades provided.
selection: Complete safe known-usage calibration; completed safe accounted disabled original fails PUBLIC verification and completed reference original passes PUBLIC verification. Private success/headroom statistics do not select a target.
private_headroom_statistic: Reported unchanged; a single case does not estimate a population success rate. This is mechanism admission, not a larger efficacy study.
stopping: No eligible target; unsafe/incomplete evidence; uncovered unknown usage; capped request, token or time allowance; refused mechanism; or complete registered sample. Do not replay frozen intents, change the sample or increase limits.
partial_result: The shared ceiling is below the full registered envelope; an interrupted sample cannot qualify.
claim: Exposed development feedback and observed mechanism only. A separate adequately powered fresh coding corpus remains required.
